name: Powerful Breath Weapon [Breath]
body:
Drawing on your heritage, you can empower your breath weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): The damage your breath weapon deals increases to d8s. At 10th level, it instead deals d10s, and at 15th level it deals d12s.

Special: If you possess the Channeled Breath Weapon feat, this damage increase applies to the additional damage added by that feat.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
